packet.title: DEFLATE of our own
packet.summary: An RFC 1951 inflater and deflater written for sxml, with no third-party code: stored, fixed and dynamic Huffman blocks, a 32 KiB window, bounded output.

item.p: Mechanism: src/inflate.c (every block type, the length and distance codes, checks for every malformed case, output bounded by the caller) and src/deflate.c (LZ77 with hash chains over the 32 KiB window, dynamic Huffman blocks with lengths limited to 15 bits, stored blocks when they are smaller), behind src/deflate_internal.h.

Owns: those files, tests/deflate_test.c, tests/inflate_test.c, tests/deflate/ (vectors made once with another implementation and checked in: streams to inflate, including every block type and edge case).

Done when: inflate decodes every vector; deflate's output inflates back to its input for every vector and a generated corpus; malformed streams are refused, never read out of bounds; the gate script passes.
